name: nl.bandzoeker/bands
title: BandZoeker
description: Find live bands, DJs and musicians for events in the Netherlands and Belgium (BandZoeker.nl).

tools.name: search_bands
tools.description: Search the live catalogue of BandZoeker.nl, the Dutch booking platform for live bands, DJs and musicians for weddings, corporate events, parties and other occasions in the Netherlands (and Belgium). Use this whenever the user wants to find, compare or book a band, DJ, cover band or musician for an event in the Netherlands or Flanders. Returns up to 6 bands as cards with photo, music styles, regions, price indication ("from" price in EUR, excl. travel costs), review score out of 10 and a link to the band page where the user can check availability and request a quote. Input may be Dutch or English. Fields that are unknown for a band are omitted; never guess a price or availability. Availability is not checked by this tool: a date is passed on to the booking form only. If nothing matches, the result suggests which filter to relax. Use get_band_details for more about one band.

query.description: Free text: band name, style, song or artist the band covers, or a short description (e.g. "Golden Earring tribute", "akoestisch duo"). Leave empty when filters say it all.

genre.description: Music style or type of act, Dutch or English. Known values: Acapella, Achtergrondmuziek, Akoestisch, Allround, Band met bn er, Blazers, Bluesband, Brassband caribisch, Chanson, Country band, Disco, DJ, Dj live muziek, Drive in show, Eighties nineties, Feestband, Folk, Funk, Gospel, Hindoestaans, Hits van nu, Iers, Interactieve pianoshow, Jaren 60, Jaren 80, Jaren 90, Jazz, Kinder, Kindermuziek, Klassiek, Latin, Medley, Met saxofonist, Nederlandstalig, Oktoberfest, Piano, Reggae, Rock, Rock n roll vintage, Singer songwriter, Soul, Surinaams, Tango, Tribute band, Wereldmuziek, Coverband.

event_type.description: Type of event, Dutch or English (e.g. wedding/bruiloft, corporate event/bedrijfsfeest). Known values: Bedrijfsfeest, Bruiloft, Carnaval, Dorpsfeest, Festival, Kerstborrel, Kinderfeest, Koningsdag, Receptie, Sportvereniging, Studentenfeest, Verjaardag, Walking dinner.

location.description: City, region or province in the Netherlands where the event takes place (e.g. "Utrecht", "Gouda", "Noord-Brabant"). Mapped to the nearest BandZoeker region.

date.description: Event date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not used to filter (availability is checked by BandZoeker after a quote request) but pre-filled in the booking form.

budget_min.description: Minimum budget in EUR for the band (compared with the band's "from" price).

budget_max.description: Maximum budget in EUR for the band (compared with the band's "from" price). Bands without a published price are left out when a budget is given.

lineup_max.description: Maximum number of musicians (bezetting), e.g. 2 for a duo.

language.description: Language of labels and links: "en" if the user writes in English, otherwise "nl".

tools.name: get_band_details
tools.description: Get the full profile of one band, DJ or act listed on BandZoeker.nl (the Dutch platform for booking live music for weddings, corporate events and parties in the Netherlands and Belgium): description, music styles, suitable occasions, regions, line-up size, price indication ("from" price in EUR), repertoire excerpt, review score with up to 3 reviews, photos, YouTube videos and the link to the band page where the user can check availability and request a quote. Use it after search_bands (pass the "slug" of a result) or when the user names a specific band. Fields that are unknown are omitted; never guess a price or availability.

band.description: The band's slug from search_bands (e.g. "the-dirty-daddies"), its exact name, or its bandzoeker.nl URL.

date.description: Optional event date (YYYY-MM-DD), pre-filled in the booking form. Availability is not checked by this tool.

language.description: Language of labels and links: "en" if the user writes in English, otherwise "nl".
